tooltips.project:
Specify the project associated with this Schedule.

Once selected:
· The Agent will execute within the project directory
· Context injections (e.g. Git changes, Issue list) will be automatically scoped to this project
· Leave unselected for a global task with no project context
tooltips.contextInjections:
Before running the Agent, automatically append selected project information to the end of the Prompt.

This allows the Agent to provide more precise analysis based on the actual state of the project, rather than generic responses.

injections.gitChanges24h:
Inject a summary of all file changes from the past 24 hours (git diff --stat) into the Prompt.
Ideal for: auto-generating daily "what changed today" progress reports.
injections.gitLogWeek:
Inject this week's commit history (git log --oneline) into the Prompt.
Ideal for: weekly reports, letting the Agent automatically summarize the week's development progress.
injections.openIssues:
Inject the list of all open issues in the project into the Prompt.
Ideal for: letting the Agent prioritize or plan based on the actual to-do list.
injections.lastResult:
Inject the output from this Schedule's last execution into the Prompt.
Ideal for: continuous tracking tasks, letting the Agent build on previous results.
injections.todayStats:
Inject today's statistics (session count, issues completed, etc.) into the Prompt.
Ideal for: end-of-day reviews, quickly summarizing the day's workload.
injections.recentErrors:
Inject error messages from recent sessions into the Prompt.
Ideal for: periodic health checks, letting the Agent automatically analyze and suggest fixes.
